bug.description: Low, observation only, not a defect proven: in the first Vite proxy run, the first proxied GET /api/rules with a valid key timed out after 5 s on the client side even though uvicorn logged 200. Two later full reruns (15 s timeout) succeeded with no repeat. Likely a cold-start artifact of the Vite dev proxy, not reproducible.
bug.reproduction: Start backend on 127.0.0.1:8000 and vite from frontend/ together, then immediately send GET http://localhost:5173/api/rules with X-API-Key; seen once in 3 runs.

verification.self_critique: Not tested: uvicorn --reload (log mask install), Docker/compose runtime, a real browser (Dashboard behaviour verified only via vitest and code reading), real Finnhub, Windows-only environment (Linux uvicorn log setup may differ, though the same dictConfig mechanism applies). Vite listens on ::1 because localhost resolved to IPv6 here; on other hosts it may bind 127.0.0.1 instead. .env.example still has VITE_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 (the IPv6 concern the orchestrator fixed only in the vite.config default); not a failure since the override is documented as unchanged. /docs and /openapi.json remain open by decision. The real .env has an APP_API_KEY= line (counted only, value not read); backend runs used explicit env overrides.
